{"notes": "Visit 5 (6:45-7:15). The picture shows the whole fish dark and connected to the start, including the crossing and the top arc. The only pale dominoes are a small stray cluster near (21-22, 11-13.5), which looks like Leo's bridge in progress. All four told me a gap remains at the crossing, but the picture doesn't show one. That contradicts Maya's earlier 114/114 report and Tom's 'connected' call. I can't tell whether something was bumped and fixed, or whether the team is misreading the crossing. Next visit: ask who last verified it, and whether the stray dominoes risk bumping the main line.

LEO: Owns the bridge and gave consistent, honest status ('first nudge didn't take'). He is working on a gap the picture doesn't show, and the pale pieces may be clutter or risk. He is still working solo and plans a single check. Ask why he believes it's open.

MAYA: Steady. She stayed hands off, set up a final check and kept the table calm. Her report now conflicts with her earlier 'all connected'. Her own building work is still unnamed, so impact is unverified.

TOM: Says he laid the bottom arc, the fin's lower edge and a tail joint fix. This is unverified but plausible, since the bottom arc is intact. He stayed hands off, as agreed. Earlier flip-flop noted.

PRIYA: She finally named her work: the fin's upper edge and the back bar. This fits Maya's earlier credit, so it is more credible, though still unwitnessed. She credited Tom and Maya for joint checks. Her public input was only an echo of Leo's plan. Still hands off."}
